description: Election Commission - Filling of a Vacancy in the Office of Member of the Katuwana Pradeshiya Sabha.
categorisation: The gazette content is specifically about filling a vacancy in a local government body (Katuwana Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a member's resignation, as per the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the process of nominating and declaring a new member elected. This falls squarely under the definition of Type 7 (Elections Gazettes), which includes electoral processes, candidate nominations/registrations, and declarations related to local authority elections. The government-related classifications (Types 1-3) do not apply, as this is not about central government structure or personnel, but a local electoral matter.
